How this was built
Topics ranked by how poorly they fit the risk that surfaced them (gap), weighted by how intense and recent they are. High-gap, high-volume, recent topics are candidate aspects of risk the current taxonomy may not fully capture. Boilerplate is filtered by content quality.
The exact search terms used to fetch news for each risk. Articles are matched to a risk when one of its terms surfaces them, so these terms define the scope of each risk's coverage.
